summary: a C4 element or boundary id is declared more than once
help: Give each element and boundary a distinct id.
rationale: Relationships and styles target ids, so a duplicate makes those targets ambiguous.

summary: a C4 relationship names an undeclared source or target
help: Declare the element, or fix the spelling.
rationale: The relationship silently points at nothing, so the drawn diagram has fewer links than the source declares.

summary: UpdateElementStyle names an undeclared element or boundary
help: Declare the element, or fix the spelling.
rationale: The style override silently applies to nothing.

summary: UpdateRelStyle names an undeclared source or target
help: Declare the relationship's elements, or fix the spelling.
rationale: The style override silently applies to nothing.
